en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: To provide an information on advanced methods of numerical modeling in the design of furniture and wood products, to know the theoretical basis of numerical analysis, finite element methods (FEM), methodological procedures for creating a computational model and simulation and practical computations of physical problems in the field.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Introduction to FEM (allowance 4/8) a.Introduction to the field.b.Advanced application of continuum mechanics and thermodynamics.c.Variational methods.d.Use of numerical methods and FEM.2.FEA (Finite Element Analyses) (allowance 5/10) a.Modeling of advanced structural, thermodynamic nonlinear problems in the ANSYS environment.b.Implementation and interpretation of nonlinear material models.c.Probabilistic modeling in furniture design in ANSYS.Topological optimization in furniture design.Shape optimization in furniture design.3.Typical problems. (allowance 5/10) a.Solving of static mechanical problems. Solving of dynamic mechanical problems.b.Thermal analysis. Advanced thermal analysis - solving bound problems.c.Defense of semester work - completion of the course.
